# Swift Backup Premium - Systemless Mount Module

Systemless Root Mount Module for Swift Backup (org.swiftapps.swiftbackup)
Compatible with Magisk, KernelSU, and APatch

--- ## 🌟 Highlights - **Full Premium Unlocked** Cloud Backups (Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV, etc.), Scheduled Backups, and complete app data restoration. - **Genuine Account & Cloud Sync** Uses the official signed stock APK base combined with systemless bind-mounting (mount -o bind) so Google Sign-In and OAuth services work flawlessly. - **Smart Conflict Protection** Detects previous signature/package conflicts, safely preserves login and session data from /data/data/org.swiftapps.swiftbackup, installs cleanly, and restores data seamlessly. - **Play Store Auto-Detach** Automatically detaches the package via zygisk-detach to protect against unwanted Play Store auto-updates. - **Direct In-App OTA Updates** Supports native one-click updates inside Magisk, KernelSU, and APatch module managers via update.json. --- ## 📥 Downloads | File | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | 📦 **[swift-backup-module-v5.1.0-all.zip](https://github.com/BabaModz-Official/swift-backup-module/releases/latest)** | **Magisk / KernelSU Module** | Systemless root module (Recommended) | | 📱 **[Swift.Backup.v5.1.0.Premium.apk](https://github.com/BabaModz-Official/swift-backup-module/releases/latest)** | **Standalone APK** | Direct standalone modded APK | --- ## ⚙️ Installation 1. Open your Root Manager (**KernelSU**, **Magisk**, or **APatch**). 2. Go to **Modules** ➔ **Install from storage**. 3. Select swift-backup-module-v5.1.0-all.zip. 4. Once flashed, open **Swift Backup** and enjoy! *(No reboot required on supported environments)*. ---

Swift Backup Premium - Systemless Mount Module

Systemless Root Mount Module for Swift Backup (org.swiftapps.swiftbackup)

Compatible with Magisk, KernelSU, and APatch

---

🌟 Highlights

  • **Full Premium Unlocked**

    • Cloud Backups (Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV, etc.), Scheduled Backups, and complete app data restoration.

  • **Genuine Account & Cloud Sync**

    • Uses the official signed stock APK base combined with systemless bind-mounting (mount -o bind) so Google Sign-In and OAuth services work flawlessly.

  • **Smart Conflict Protection**

    • Detects previous signature/package conflicts, safely preserves login and session data from /data/data/org.swiftapps.swiftbackup, installs cleanly, and restores data seamlessly.

  • **Play Store Auto-Detach**

    • Automatically detaches the package via zygisk-detach to protect against unwanted Play Store auto-updates.

  • **Direct In-App OTA Updates**

    • Supports native one-click updates inside Magisk, KernelSU, and APatch module managers via update.json.

    ---

    📥 Downloads

    | File | Type | Description |

    |---|---|---|

    | 📦 swift-backup-module-v5.1.0-all.zip | Magisk / KernelSU Module | Systemless root module (Recommended) |

    | 📱 Swift.Backup.v5.1.0.Premium.apk | Standalone APK | Direct standalone modded APK |

    ---

    ⚙️ Installation

  • Open your Root Manager (**KernelSU**, **Magisk**, or **APatch**).
  • Go to **Modules** ➔ **Install from storage**.
  • Select swift-backup-module-v5.1.0-all.zip.
  • Once flashed, open **Swift Backup** and enjoy! *(No reboot required on supported environments)*.

    • ---

    Maintained with ❤️ by BabaModz
